name: Template Reanimation Spell
displayText: Return up to one Unit card costing 3 or less from your discard pile to the battlefield Exhausted. It is Newly Deployed.

text.flavor: `move_card` covers every zone transition. `toZone: "battlefield"` is a revival: the card arrives Newly Deployed and fires `entersBattlefield`, never `deployed`. `entersExhausted` is part of that arrival and is legal nowhere else. `toZone: "removed"` is terminal. `optional: true` is the "up to".
